coordinates.definition: Overall wrist acceleration average using the UK Biobank field90012 definition and its calibration/wear-time eligibility; each occasion summarizes its specified monitoring window
UK Biobank field20023 matching-card reaction-time summary: exclude training rounds0-4 and responses outside50-2000ms, retain matching-card responses, round mean to wholems; not general intelligence

definition.functional_operator: Separate computerized reaction measurement with a declared additive-error approximation to the occasion summary. Validity of that approximation is stipulated, not calibrated from the source.
definition.population_scope: Hypothetical independent adult sample; not UK Biobank participant data
definition.question: Can linked activity and cognitive measurements resolve their individual changes and population relationship?
definition.tolerance_authority: Illustrative native resolutions chosen for a reproducible software example; not clinical thresholds or adopted AniBench level. Joint observer/function criteria retain separate units.

scope: One source-inspired hypothetical question; not a UKB score or adopted broad reference
selection_rationale: Checks linked digital and independently measured cognitive observations
weighting_rationale: One fixed question budget per category, no overall aggregate
